content:
devin: kicking off Hyperion POC perf run now. goal: validate mixed-search workload at 3k sustained qps with 4k microbursts. posting live notes.
zoe: what's the traffic mix and infra?
devin: mix = 72% embeddings (seq=96), 28% generation (seq=256 max_gen=128). infra: Dedicated 6x A10g-eq, model family: hyper-embed-3b + hyper-gen-7b-4bit. batching=continuous, max_batch_tokens=8192, batch_timeout_ms=15.
patrick: started loadgen. initial 10m: sustained qps ~2.95k, embed p50=24ms p95=150ms p99=410ms. gen p95=360ms p99=1.05s.
ops-bot: autoscaler: pool util 96% at 6259876578; reserved capacity reached; burst not enabled.
devin: quick logs paste: 
```
[6259876579] req=E401 slot=gpu-3 qlen=10 batch_tks=7200 p95=148ms p99=392ms gpu_util=87% nvlink=74% cache_hit=0.93
[6259876582] req=G112 slot=gpu-5 qlen=2 batch_tks=180 p95=36ms p99=110ms gpu_util=28% nvlink=11% cache_hit=0.99
[6259876591] req=E450 slot=gpu-1 qlen=14 batch_tks=9200 p95=220ms p99=820ms gpu_util=99% nvlink=92% cache_hit=0.58
```
devin: note the cache_hit drop before big p99s and NVLink spike.
zoe: sounds like KV churn + large generation landing on a worker with small cached KV. Could be memcpy/NVLink saturation.
patrick: customer asked if burst will "fix" the p99s and wants a clear sentence for the contract. sales-amy needs wording and a ballpark cost.
sales-amy: yes please; short paragraph + per-minute burst estimate and security note (SOC2/HSM) would be great.
infra-luis: short answer: burst reduces queueing and the queuing-amplified tail. It doesn't eliminate cold-cache stalls from single long generations. Combine burst + prefix cache tuning + pinned long-gen route for best results.
ops-bot: cost_estimate: burst 30m/day expected overhead ~+$0.10/min -> ~$45/mo (rough).
devin: plan for reproducer and immediate mitigations: 1) run 20m A/B where we toggle prefix_cache on/off; 2) decrease batch_timeout_ms to 8ms; 3) increase max_batch_tokens to 12288 for one run; 4) create pinned route "long-gen-warm" and reserve 1 GPU equiv; 5) enable burst for the validation run.
zoe: loadgen command I'm using: 
```
./loadgen --target 3000 --burst 4000 --mix "embed:0.72:seq=96,gen:0.28:seq=256" --duration 1200 --tag hyperion-pass1
```
patrick: can you also dump sequence-length CDF and token-gen time CSV? sales wants the % of requests >128 tokens.
devin: pushed CSV to shared drive /poc/hyperion/625987-results.csv. shows ~5.7% of requests generate >128 tokens and those align with ~78% of big spikes.
zoe: ran quick A/B: cache off -> embed p95=168ms p99=460ms; cache on -> embed p95=110ms p99=300ms. batch_timeout=8ms -> further reduces p95 by ~10-15ms but can lower batching efficiency.
infra-luis: kernel traces I pulled: memcpy spikes and NVLink throughput saturates when long gens start on hot workers; multi-device reduction for embed path helps NVLink but doesn't solve large-generation memcpy.
patrick: ok, short sales-friendly summary: "Enabling prefix caching and a pinned long-gen warm route materially reduces median and tail for mixed traffic. Burst autoscaling reduces queueing-amplified tails but rare single-request long generations may still create p99 spikes; recommend soft max_gen or streaming chunking for strict tail guarantees."
sales-amy: good. can you give an exact recommended config we tested so I can put in the quote?
devin: recommended config tested: prefix_cache_enabled=true, cache_max_entries=25000, batch_timeout_ms=8, max_batch_tokens=12288, create route long-gen-warm pinned to 1 GPU equiv, enable burst windows (30m/day) during peak.
ops-bot: change_request: enable_burst_autoscale(hyperion-poc) submitted by devin at 6259876620  pending infra-luis approval.
infra-luis: approved. enabling burst now.
zoe: re-run 30m validation with all mitigations: results condensed -> embed p50=22ms p95=108ms p99=220ms; gen p95=240ms p99=380ms. burst noticeably reduced the highest tails.
patrick: perfect. can you also note any quality or model tradeoffs?
devin: we tested 4-bit quant for gen vs fp16: 4-bit gave ~1.9x throughput with negligible quality regression on our internal eval, but customer should run their domain eval; flag as possible small generation artifact risk.
sales-amy: security/compliance wording please so I can attach to RFP: 
infra-luis: security blurb: "Data encrypted in transit and at rest using KMS. Private deployment supports customer-managed keys and HSM-backed key stores (lead time ~3-4 weeks). SOC2 Type II evidence available on request."
sales-amy: I'll send that with the one-paragraph exec summary and the estimated burst cost (~$45/mo). thanks team.
ops-bot: scheduled 30m post-validation capture at 6259877000.
devin: next steps: 1) run customer-sampled 60m validation with traces, 2) prepare single-slide summary for sales (p50/p95/p99 + config + cost), 3) pricing to include optional burst + routing SOW.
zoe: if we still see rare >500ms spikes after full run, we'll propose per-request soft limit or streaming as fail-safe.
patrick: thanks everyone  will collate and send to Hyperion. :thumbsup:
